title: Eldridge Exiled

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Sigh.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sigh.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: No. Don't speak to me. Leave before you STAIN yourself by standing in my presence.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. Don't speak to me. Leave before you STAIN yourself by standing in my presence.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Oh, don't pretend you don't know! It's why I'm stuck in this terrible place!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, don't pretend you don't know! It's why I'm stuck in this terrible place!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: See Eldridge... even the unstylish won't speak to you. You deserve it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See Eldridge... even the unstylish won't speak to you. You deserve it.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Ghastly. The lewd sun, the revolting sand. It's unfathomable that people live like this all year round.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ghastly. The lewd sun, the revolting sand. It's unfathomable that people live like this all year round.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: WAS from the Spire. I once lived on the 90th floor of the Curzona's Fourth Tower... before I did The Thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: WAS from the Spire. I once lived on the 90th floor of the Curzona's Fourth Tower... before I did The Thing.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: You must be one of those offgridders. Otherwise you would have heard. To make such a faux pas as I did... surely the whole of the Nets is talking about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You must be one of those offgridders. Otherwise you would have heard. To make such a faux pas as I did... surely the whole of the Nets is talking about it.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Oh! Exile for Eldridge-Uchuu, exile for a thousand years!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh! Exile for Eldridge-Uchuu, exile for a thousand years!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: A Nyx-Curzona. We're one of the better branches. I'm thirty-eighth in line to the Chair of the Board. Or I was...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A Nyx-Curzona. We're one of the better branches. I'm thirty-eighth in line to the Chair of the Board. Or I was...

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Business. Such a dirty word. You should see it has done to my Aunt Mary. She wears the same suit, every day! Can you imagine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Business. Such a dirty word. You should see it has done to my Aunt Mary. She wears the same suit, every day! Can you imagine.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Ugh, my aunt. You know she wears the same suit every day? Can you imagine? That's what business does to a person.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ugh, my aunt. You know she wears the same suit every day? Can you imagine? That's what business does to a person.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: I don't care about any of that. I leave business to my Aunt Mary.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't care about any of that. I leave business to my Aunt Mary.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Mary Nyx Curzona. Don't tell me you haven't heard of her either? Honestly, I'm jealous. It must be so freeing to be poor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mary Nyx Curzona. Don't tell me you haven't heard of her either? Honestly, I'm jealous. It must be so freeing to be poor.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: The truth is... the terrible truth is... I can't remember! Curse Bo Bo and his psychedelic snuff!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The truth is... the terrible truth is... I can't remember! Curse Bo Bo and his psychedelic snuff!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: How can I care about anything when I am a PARIAH?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How can I care about anything when I am a PARIAH?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: All these questions! How can you expect me to care about anything when I'm a PARIAH?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All these questions! How can you expect me to care about anything when I'm a PARIAH?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: NO. I came to POV Party in the LUZ, but some time during the night I made a breach of etiquette so bad that I ran away here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: NO. I came to POV Party in the LUZ, but some time during the night I made a breach of etiquette so bad that I ran away here.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: You do? But how could you? You're so unstylish.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You do? But how could you? You're so unstylish.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: *sniff*... the what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: *sniff*... the what?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: I would never drink BEER.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would never drink BEER.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: But how will I ever discover what it was? The Comms are down, my butlers are gone... we can't even get the fashion Holos here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But how will I ever discover what it was? The Comms are down, my butlers are gone... we can't even get the fashion Holos here.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: NO. No. I shall just... become a crab and die. That would be preferable to showing my face again. Ohh...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: NO. No. I shall just... become a crab and die. That would be preferable to showing my face again. Ohh...

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: You could? I suppose if you pretended to be a reporter, writing an elegy to my disgrace... yes, it could work...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could? I suppose if you pretended to be a reporter, writing an elegy to my disgrace... yes, it could work...

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: I don't carry anything as grubby as Lims, but I could give you something...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't carry anything as grubby as Lims, but I could give you something...

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Let me think, there was me, Bo Bo, Minty, PorridgeDog...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let me think, there was me, Bo Bo, Minty, PorridgeDog...

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Lucy the Duchess Lovelace, some kid called Razzy or Razzo, Ziggy on bar... after that I can't remember.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lucy the Duchess Lovelace, some kid called Razzy or Razzo, Ziggy on bar... after that I can't remember.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Just don't say you've seen me like this! In my degradation!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just don't say you've seen me like this! In my degradation!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you OK?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you OK?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you OK?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you OK?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why, what have you done?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why, what have you done?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why, what have you done?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why, what have you done?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gladly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gladly.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Gladly.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Gladly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think this place is terrible?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think this place is terrible?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You think this place is terrible?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You think this place is terrible?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know who you are and I don't care.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know who you are and I don't care.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't know who you are and I don't care.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't know who you are and I don't care.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let me guess: you're from the Spire.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let me guess: you're from the Spire.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Let me guess: you're from the Spire.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Let me guess: you're from the Spire.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What did you do? Wear the wrong hat or something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What did you do? Wear the wrong hat or something?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What did you do? Wear the wrong hat or something?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What did you do? Wear the wrong hat or something?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like I said, don't know, don't care.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like I said, don't know, don't care.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Like I said, don't know, don't care.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Like I said, don't know, don't care.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're a Curzona?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a Curzona?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're a Curzona?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're a Curzona?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "The Thing?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "The Thing?"
pronounText.TextSheVersion: "The Thing?"
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: "The Thing?"

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you related to Mary Nyx Curzona?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you related to Mary Nyx Curzona?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you related to Mary Nyx Curzona?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you related to Mary Nyx Curzona?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Curzona make people's lives a misery.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Curzona make people's lives a misery.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Curzona make people's lives a misery.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Curzona make people's lives a misery.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you must have some good business contacts...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you must have some good business contacts...?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you must have some good business contacts...?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you must have some good business contacts...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You should care.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should care.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You should care.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You should care.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mary?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mary?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Mary?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Mary?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where can I find her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where can I find her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Where can I find her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Where can I find her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you might be here for nothing...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you might be here for nothing...?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you might be here for nothing...?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you might be here for nothing...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, I'm sure the years will pass quickly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I'm sure the years will pass quickly.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, I'm sure the years will pass quickly.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, I'm sure the years will pass quickly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I know what you're suffering from.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I know what you're suffering from.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I know what you're suffering from.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I know what you're suffering from.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: At least I'm not a pariah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: At least I'm not a pariah.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: At least I'm not a pariah.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: At least I'm not a pariah.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you've got a severe case of the morbs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you've got a severe case of the morbs.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think you've got a severe case of the morbs.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think you've got a severe case of the morbs.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The morbs. Beer fear. The post party scaries.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The morbs. Beer fear. The post party scaries.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The morbs. Beer fear. The post party scaries.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The morbs. Beer fear. The post party scaries.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Look, whatever you did, it's probably not that bad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, whatever you did, it's probably not that bad.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Look, whatever you did, it's probably not that bad.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Look, whatever you did, it's probably not that bad.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Guess you'll just have to face the music.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Guess you'll just have to face the music.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Guess you'll just have to face the music.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Guess you'll just have to face the music.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I could ask around.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could ask around.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I could ask around.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I could ask around.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Leave it to me. Who shall I talk to?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Leave it to me. Who shall I talk to?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Leave it to me. Who shall I talk to?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Leave it to me. Who shall I talk to?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There'd be a fee, of course.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There'd be a fee, of course.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There'd be a fee, of course.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There'd be a fee, of course.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: As long as it's valuable. So, who should I talk to?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As long as it's valuable. So, who should I talk to?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: As long as it's valuable. So, who should I talk to?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: As long as it's valuable. So, who should I talk to?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm going now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm going now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm going now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm going now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ... PorridgeDog?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... PorridgeDog?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: ... PorridgeDog?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: ... PorridgeDog?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll see what I turn up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll see what I turn up.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll see what I turn up.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll see what I turn up.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You bet I can.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You bet I can.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You bet I can.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You bet I can.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then it can't be that important, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then it can't be that important, right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Then it can't be that important, right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Then it can't be that important, right?
